FN-BY1E8JJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 155
Committee: Military and Veterans' Affairs Sponsor: Representative Paul W. Lee
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 155 as introduced would allow disabled veterans to no longer annually verify or
claim thier homestead exemption after initial qualification. This bill would not affect state or
local funding.
